description: Sleep-disorder condition profile anchored to international classifications (ICSD-3 + ICD-11) — classification reference ONLY, never a diagnostic instrument (N1/N5). Wave 1 = obstructive + central sleep apnea. Carries the stable slug, coded references, and a brand-neutral lay description with a mandatory disclaimer. Per ADR-2606072800 §Decision 1/6.

displayNameJa.description: e.g., 閉塞性睡眠時無呼吸 (OSA).

icsd3Code.description: ICSD-3 classification reference (anchor only — sourceClass icsd-3, classification-only grade).

icd11Code.description: WHO ICD-11 code (e.g., 7A40 obstructive / 7A41 central). Anchor only.

layDescription.description: Brand-neutral lay description of the condition (what it is, why it matters). NOT a self-diagnosis checklist (N1). Diagnosis is by PSG/OCST + clinician only.

redFlagNote.description: G5 red-flag guidance text (e.g., 重度日中傾眠での運転 / 心不全合併 → 速やかに受診).

treatmentSlugs.description: Stable treatment-modality slugs associated with this condition (synthesis targets), e.g., cpap / oral-appliance-mad / positional-therapy / weight-loss-lifestyle / upper-airway-surgery / hypoglossal-nerve-stimulation / adaptive-servo-ventilation.
